items.title: EM3DFold: accurate de novo protein and nucleic acid model building for cryo-EM maps using language model-powered deep learning
items.abstract_or_text: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become one of the most powerful techniques for macromolecular structure determination. However, accurate model building from cryo-EM maps remains challenging, particularly for nucleic acids. Here, we present EM3DFold, a unified de novo model-building framework for accurate structure determination of proteins, nucleic acids, and protein-nucleic acid complexes from cryo-EM maps using a density-aware, large language model-powered three-track attention (TTA) network. The TTA network effectively integrates sequence, density, and structural information to enable accurate all-atom model building. EM3DFold was extensively evaluated on independent benchmarks of 298 experimental cryo-EM maps at < 4.0 [A] resolutions, and achieves an unprecedentedly high median accuracy of 75% completeness (88% coverage and 94% sequence accuracy) for 178 nucleic acid maps, 90% completeness (95% coverage and 96% sequence accuracy) for 124 protein-nucleic acid complexes, and 95% completeness (97% coverage and 98% sequence accuracy) for 120 protein-only targets, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art methods including ModelAngelo, EM2NA, CryoREAD, and EMProt. In addition, EM3DFold also produces models with superior model-to-map fit and stereochemical quality, providing a robust and reliable solution for automated cryo-EM model building. The EM3DFold package is freely available at https://github.com/huang-laboratory/EM3DFold.
items.summary_zh: EM3DFold以密度感知的大语言模型三轨注意力网络，联合序列、cryo-EM密度图和结构信息，实现蛋白质、核酸及其复合物的从头全原子建模；在298张独立实验cryo-EM图谱上的评测显示其优于多种现有自动建模工具。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 核酸及蛋白-核酸复合物的高质量自动建模是结构生物学的重要瓶颈。该工作提供了覆盖多类大分子的统一框架，并有独立实验图谱基准和开源代码支持；但目前仍是预印本，报告的性能主要来自作者设定的基准，跨分辨率、样本类型和下游人工校验流程的稳健性仍需独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）已成为测定大分子结构最强大的技术之一。然而，从cryo-EM图谱进行准确的模型构建仍具挑战性，尤其是对核酸而言。在此，我们提出EM3DFold：一个统一的从头模型构建框架，利用密度感知、由大语言模型驱动的三轨注意力（TTA）网络，从cryo-EM图谱中准确测定蛋白质、核酸以及蛋白质-核酸复合物的结构。TTA网络有效整合序列、密度和结构信息，从而实现准确的全原子模型构建。EM3DFold在298张分辨率＜4.0 [A]的实验cryo-EM图谱独立基准上接受了广泛评估：对于178张核酸图谱，实现了75%完整度的前所未有的高中位准确性（88%覆盖率和94%序列准确率）；对于124个蛋白质-核酸复合物，实现90%完整度（95%覆盖率和96%序列准确率）；对于120个仅含蛋白质的目标，实现95%完整度（97%覆盖率和98%序列准确率），显著优于包括ModelAngelo、EM2NA、CryoREAD和EMProt在内的最先进方法。此外，EM3DFold还产生了具有更优模型-图谱拟合度和立体化学质量的模型，为自动化cryo-EM模型构建提供了稳健可靠的解决方案。EM3DFold软件包可在https://github.com/huang-laboratory/EM3DFold免费获取。
items.author_line: Li, T., Cao, H., Huang, S.-Y.

items.title: Conditional Generation And Inpainting Of Non-coding RNA Sequences With Masked Discrete Diffusion
items.abstract_or_text: Designing functional non-coding RNA (ncRNA) is fundamental to synthetic biology and RNA therapeutics, yet generative modelling for ncRNA has received far less attention than protein design. We present RNA-MDLM, a framework that extends Masked Discrete Language Models (MDLM) to the conditional generation and inpainting of ncRNA. We make two additions: first, conditioning on RNA-type representations from a pretrained RNA language model, and second, a modified classifier-free guidance scheme (Mod-CFG) that interpolates among conditional, unconditional, and random-sequence probabilities for better control. We also introduce REPAINT GAMES, a benchmark of seven structured masking tasks to probe a model's performance on sequence patterns, structural motifs, and base-pairing per RNA type. Our model is trained on 4.6 million ncRNA sequences spanning six evaluable classes. It produces sequences whose composition and folding statistics closely match natural RNAs. Through extensive ablation studies, we find that the embedding-conditioned model achieves the best balance of structural fidelity, biological novelty, and inpainting accuracy, and its class label steers generation far more strongly than a plain label baseline. We further show that a model trained on a smaller, class-balanced subset can appear more realistic mainly by copying abundant natural sequences rather than learning their rules. We also benchmark against a masked-diffusion model and a family-specific VAE on ribozyme families, and find that a type-conditioned model like ours and a per-family model are solving different tasks, which must be accounted for in a fair comparison. We will release the code and the trained models.
items.summary_zh: RNA-MDLM将Masked Discrete Language Models扩展至ncRNA的条件生成和序列补全，以预训练RNA语言模型的RNA类型表征及改进的classifier-free guidance控制生成；作者还提出REPAINT GAMES基准，并在460万条ncRNA序列上进行训练与消融评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把生成式模型推进到较少被系统探索的功能性ncRNA设计，并正面讨论小型类别平衡数据集可能因复制高丰度天然序列而造成的虚假真实感。其结论受到训练数据代表性、计算折叠指标与真实功能之间差距的限制，且摘要未报告湿实验功能验证；代码和模型尚为计划发布。
items.abstract_zh: 功能性非编码RNA（ncRNA）的设计是合成生物学和RNA疗法的基础，但ncRNA的生成建模受到的关注远少于蛋白质设计。我们提出RNA-MDLM，这是一个将Masked Discrete Language Models（MDLM）扩展到ncRNA条件生成和补全的框架。我们进行了两项新增设计：第一，基于预训练RNA语言模型中的RNA类型表征进行条件化；第二，采用改进的classifier-free guidance方案（Mod-CFG），在条件、无条件和随机序列概率之间插值，以实现更好的控制。我们还引入REPAINT GAMES，这是一个由七项结构化掩码任务组成的基准，用于探测模型在不同RNA类型的序列模式、结构基序和碱基配对上的表现。我们的模型在涵盖六个可评估类别的460万条ncRNA序列上训练。它生成的序列，其组成和折叠统计特征与天然RNA高度匹配。通过广泛的消融研究，我们发现，以嵌入为条件的模型在结构保真度、生物学新颖性和补全准确性之间实现了最佳平衡，并且其类别标签对生成的引导作用远强于仅用普通标签的基线。我们进一步表明，在较小的类别平衡子集上训练的模型看起来可能更真实，主要是因为复制了高丰度的天然序列，而不是学习了其规律。我们还在核酶家族上与掩码扩散模型和家族特异性VAE进行了基准比较，发现像我们这样的类型条件模型与逐家族模型解决的是不同任务，公平比较时必须考虑这一点。我们将发布代码和训练好的模型。
items.author_line: Upadhyay, U., Dai, C., Herold, J., Sato, K., Schug, A.

items.title: Pep-PU-GAN: Positive-Unlabeled Adversarial Learning for Peptide Function Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Peptide classification remains challenging in bioinformatics because of limited labeled data, particularly the scarcity of verified negative examples, and the complex relationship between amino acid sequences and biological functions. This study introduces Pep-PU-GAN, a deep learning framework that combines positive-unlabeled (PU) learning, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and graph neural networks (GNNs) for peptide classification. Peptides are represented as sequence-derived residue graphs, with amino acids as nodes and edges connecting adjacent residues, enabling attention-based message passing over local neighborhoods. The architecture includes a generator that produces synthetic peptide embeddings in encoder space and a dual-function discriminator that distinguishes real from synthetic embeddings while performing PU classification. Training uses a custom loss integrating non-negative PU (nnPU) risk estimation with adversarial objectives. A self-training mechanism further incorporates high-confidence synthetic positive embeddings to augment the training set and improve performance. Evaluated on neuropeptide classification using 4,049 positive neuropeptides and 8,558 unlabeled peptides, Pep-PU-GAN outperformed baseline models, achieving an F1 score of 0.93 and an AUROC of 0.98 on an independent held-out benchmark. Pep-PU-GAN provides a promising approach for peptide classification tasks with scarce labeled and abundant unlabeled data, with potential applications in computational biology and drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: Pep-PU-GAN结合正例-未标注学习、GAN和GNN，将肽表示为残基图，并通过合成嵌入和双功能判别器处理稀缺负例问题。在4,049条正例神经肽与8,558条未标注肽的任务中，模型在独立留出基准上报告F1为0.93、AUROC为0.98。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 肽功能预测常受可靠负例缺乏制约，PU学习与图表示的组合具有实际价值，也可能服务于先导肽筛选。需要注意的是，结果仍限于单一神经肽分类任务和计算留出集；合成正例的真实性、数据切分是否充分消除序列同源性泄漏，以及对其他肽功能和实验测定的外推性尚未在摘要中得到验证。
items.abstract_zh: 由于标记数据有限，尤其是经验证负例稀缺，以及氨基酸序列与生物学功能之间关系复杂，肽分类在生物信息学中仍具挑战性。本研究提出Pep-PU-GAN，这是一个用于肽分类的深度学习框架，结合了正例-未标注（PU）学习、生成对抗网络（GAN）和图神经网络（GNN）。肽被表示为由序列导出的残基图，其中氨基酸作为节点、相邻残基之间的连接作为边，从而能够在局部邻域上进行基于注意力的消息传递。该架构包括一个在编码器空间中生成合成肽嵌入的生成器，以及一个双功能判别器：它既区分真实与合成嵌入，也执行PU分类。训练采用自定义损失，将非负PU（nnPU）风险估计与对抗目标相结合。自训练机制还进一步纳入高置信度合成正例嵌入以扩增训练集并提升性能。在神经肽分类任务上，以4,049条正例神经肽和8,558条未标注肽进行评估时，Pep-PU-GAN优于基线模型，在独立留出基准上实现0.93的F1分数和0.98的AUROC。Pep-PU-GAN为标记数据稀缺、未标注数据丰富的肽分类任务提供了一种有前景的方法，并在计算生物学和药物发现中具有潜在应用。
items.author_line: Midjani, F., Hashemi, S., Keshtkar, F. Z., Malekpour, M., Saberzadeh Ardestani, B., Khosravi, B.

items.title: AI-Powered Discovery of Novel RNA Viruses from the Permafrost of a 14,300-Year-Old Pleistocene Wolf
items.abstract_or_text: Ancient viruses preserved as molecular relics offer rare and often unpredictable insights into virus-host co-evolution and the ecological dynamics of past ecosystems. However, the recovery of ancient RNA viruses via paleotranscriptomics has remained largely unexplored, constrained by the inherent chemical instability of RNA and the lack of sensitive detection tools capable of identifying deeply divergent sequences. Here, we leveraged recent advances in artificial intelligence and high-throughput sequencing to conduct comprehensive metatranscriptomic mining of publicly available RNA-seq datasets from three ancient or extinct host species: the woolly mammoth (Mammuthus primigenius), the Tasmanian tiger (Thylacinus cynocephalus), and the gray wolf (Canis lupus). We performed sensitive homology searches using the AI-driven protein language model Lucaprot, coupled with structural validation via AlphaFold2, to screen billions of raw sequencing reads for conserved viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp) signature genes. Our pipeline identified two near-complete previously unknown RNA viruses in a 14,300-year-old Pleistocene wolf specimen. Phylogenetic analyses placed them within established mycovirus genera (Duamitovirus and Orthocurvulavirus), indicating they infected fungi that inhabited the carcass rather than the wolf itself. Despite deep sequence divergence from known viruses (57.6% and 60.8% RdRp amino acid identity, respectively), the catalytic A, B, and C motifs remain structurally intact. Strict authentication through multiple analyses firmly verified their ancient provenance. To our knowledge, this is the earliest documented evidence of novel RNA viruses persisting within a host-associated microbiome, extending the observed preservation timescale from centuries to over fourteen millennia. Our findings demonstrate that permafrost is a viable substrate for paleovirological discovery extending beyond the host organism and opening new opportunities for reconstructing ancient microbial and viral ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以Lucaprot进行敏感同源搜索、以AlphaFold2进行结构验证，对三种古代或灭绝宿主的公开RNA-seq数据做宏转录组挖掘，在一头14,300年前更新世狼样本中发现两种近完整的新RNA病毒；系统发育结果表明它们更可能感染尸体中的真菌而非狼。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作展示了蛋白语言模型和结构预测可扩展古病毒组发现的序列灵敏度，并通过多重分析支持古代来源。其生物学解释仍应谨慎：发现来自公开测序数据，病毒宿主归属主要由系统发育推断得出，摘要未提供分离培养、感染性或功能实验；作为预印本，古代来源认证和分类也有待独立复核。
items.abstract_zh: 作为分子遗存保存下来的古病毒，为病毒-宿主共演化和过去生态系统的生态动态提供了罕见且往往难以预测的见解。然而，借助古转录组学回收古代RNA病毒仍在很大程度上未被探索，受制于RNA固有的化学不稳定性，以及缺乏能够识别深度分化序列的灵敏检测工具。在此，我们利用人工智能和高通量测序的最新进展，对来自三种古代或灭绝宿主物种——猛犸象（Mammuthus primigenius）、袋狼（Thylacinus cynocephalus）和灰狼（Canis lupus）——的公开RNA-seq数据集进行了全面的宏转录组挖掘。我们采用由AI驱动的蛋白语言模型Lucaprot进行灵敏同源性搜索，并结合AlphaFold2的结构验证，筛查数十亿条原始测序读段，以寻找保守的病毒RNA依赖RNA聚合酶（RdRp）标志基因。我们的流程在一份14,300年前更新世狼标本中鉴定出两种近乎完整、此前未知的RNA病毒。系统发育分析将它们归入既有的真菌病毒属（Duamitovirus和Orthocurvulavirus），表明它们感染的是栖居于尸体中的真菌而非狼本身。尽管与已知病毒存在深度序列分化（RdRp氨基酸同一性分别为57.6%和60.8%），催化A、B和C基序在结构上仍保持完整。通过多项分析进行的严格认证有力验证了其古代来源。据我们所知，这是在宿主相关微生物组中持续存在的新RNA病毒最早的有文献记载证据，将已观察到的保存时间尺度从数百年延长至一万四千多年。我们的发现表明，永久冻土是开展超越宿主生物体的古病毒学发现的可行基质，并为重建古代微生物和病毒生态系统开辟了新机遇。
items.author_line: Zaheer ud Din, S., Wu, Q.

items.title: Virtual experiments bridge sequence and microscopy with generative models
items.abstract_or_text: Large-scale screening and mapping efforts have produced vast libraries of perturbation-readout data. Converting these measurements into mechanistic insights requires models that link perturbation and genetic input to phenotypes, i.e., labels from experimental readouts, which are usually task specific. We propose a different, virtual experiment modeling approach: train generative models to recreate readouts conditioned on the experimental context, and then let established downstream models extract phenotypes from the synthetic data. As an illustrative case, we develop a bidirectional sequence-image generative framework, CELL-FM, that maps protein sequence and cellular context to fluorescence microscopy images and back, enabling in silico localization prediction, image-conditioned functional motif analysis and generation, and large-scale virtual mutagenesis revealing the amino acid features controlling condensate formation of intrinsically disordered peptides. This approach decouples representation learning from task-specific annotation, reuses rich experimental modalities across many downstream tasks, and preserves the spatial and organizational detail that hand-crafted labels often discard.
items.summary_zh: CELL-FM是一个双向序列-图像生成框架，将蛋白质序列与细胞环境映射至荧光显微图像并可反向映射，用于体外定位预测、图像条件化功能基序分析与生成，以及揭示内在无序肽凝聚体形成控制特征的大规模虚拟突变。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将生成模型直接用于重建实验读出，而非仅预测手工定义标签，可能提升扰动—表型数据在多项下游任务中的复用价值。摘要没有给出定量基准、外部验证或生成图像与真实实验之间误差的细节，因此其机制推断和虚拟突变结果仍需以独立成像及功能实验确认。
items.abstract_zh: 大规模筛选和图谱绘制工作已产生了庞大的扰动-读出数据文库。将这些测量结果转化为机制性见解，需要能够将扰动和遗传输入连接到表型的模型，即来自实验读出的标签，而这些标签通常是任务特异性的。我们提出了一种不同的虚拟实验建模方法：训练生成模型，以实验背景为条件重建读出，然后让既有的下游模型从合成数据中提取表型。作为示例案例，我们开发了一个双向序列-图像生成框架CELL-FM，它将蛋白质序列和细胞背景映射为荧光显微图像并可反向映射，从而实现计算机模拟的定位预测、图像条件化的功能基序分析与生成，以及大规模虚拟突变，以揭示控制内在无序肽凝聚体形成的氨基酸特征。这种方法将表征学习与任务特异性标注解耦，在许多下游任务中复用丰富的实验模态，并保留手工构建标签常常丢弃的空间和组织细节。
items.author_line: Zheng, D., Hong, K., Huang, B.

items.title: A diffusion model of viral evolution predicts mutation fitness and evolutionary trajectories
items.abstract_or_text: Viral evolution arises from random mutations and natural selection, yet computational approaches rarely model these two forces in a unified way. We present Viral Evolution Simulator (VES), a diffusion model-based framework that mirrors this duality by design: forward noise injection simulates stochastic mutation, and reverse denoising recapitulates selective filtering. Trained solely on viral protein sequences, VES predicts mutational fitness without functional data, measuring fitness as the reconstruction difficulty of a mutated sequence relative to its wild-type counterpart. Across immune escape, receptor binding, and deep mutational scanning datasets, VES outperforms state-of-the-art generative models, achieving a 31.78% error reduction over the best baseline in immune escape mutation fitting evaluation. When trained on sequences collected before June 2024 and evaluated against H1N1 strains that later emerged, VES assigned high scores to 16 of 20 mutations that subsequently showed the sharpest frequency shifts. Extending to avian influenza H5, the framework reveals a dynamic interplay between antigenic escape and human-type receptor binding. Both functions dropped sharply in 2021, followed by a sustained rise in receptor affinity that could connect to recent epidemiological trends. VES offers a generalizable, sequence-only foundation for tracing evolutionary trajectories and prioritizing mutations for surveillance and experimental validation, pointing toward where functional efforts might matter most.
items.summary_zh: VES以扩散模型的前向加噪模拟随机突变、反向去噪模拟选择，仅凭病毒蛋白序列预测突变适合度和演化轨迹。其在免疫逃逸、受体结合及深度突变扫描数据集上优于基线，并以前瞻性H1N1序列和H5分析展示了监测候选突变的潜力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将突变与选择置于同一生成机制中，并在后来出现的H1N1毒株上做时间外评估，使该方法对病毒监测和突变优先级排序具有吸引力。适合度被定义为重建难度而非直接功能测量，流行频率还会受采样与流行病学因素影响；摘要中的H5趋势关联和预测结果仍需要前瞻性实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 病毒进化源于随机突变和自然选择，但计算方法很少以统一的方式建模这两种力量。我们提出Viral Evolution Simulator（VES），这是一个基于扩散模型的框架，其设计上反映了这种二元性：前向噪声注入模拟随机突变，反向去噪重现选择性过滤。VES仅在病毒蛋白序列上训练，无需功能数据即可预测突变适合度；它将适合度定义为突变序列相对于其野生型对应序列的重建难度。在免疫逃逸、受体结合和深度突变扫描数据集上，VES优于最先进的生成模型，在免疫逃逸突变拟合评估中，相比最佳基线实现31.78%的误差降低。当使用2024年6月前采集的序列训练、并针对后来出现的H1N1毒株进行评估时，VES为随后频率变化最显著的20个突变中的16个赋予了高分。扩展到禽流感H5后，该框架揭示了抗原逃逸与人型受体结合之间的动态相互作用。两种功能均在2021年急剧下降，随后受体亲和力持续上升，这可能与近期流行病学趋势有关。VES为追踪进化轨迹以及为监测和实验验证优先排序突变提供了可泛化、仅依赖序列的基础，并指向功能研究最可能重要的方向。
